craft_notes: Sthāyin: empty-city (left→outside-inside-no-one: the census of absence — then Śakti's mode seen → Śiva proceeds: THE double-act of the text: goddess acts, Śiva proceeds). Rows: row 3 (inner-thought→Śiva proceeds). Close: proceeds (pravartate — the motion-verb after census: motion from absence). Rejected: 'abandon the body' — killed: city left kept (the CITY leaves, not you: nagarī = head-region per L0); 'Shiva acts' — killed: Śakti's mode seen kept FIRST: she is the seeing, he the proceeding (the causality order is doctrine).

lines: City left — outside, inside, no one in:
Śakti's mode, seen in inner thought — Śiva proceeds.
